_notes.measures: retrieval of content from the query's own patent
_notes.why: raw abstracts share ~55% verbatim tokens with their own claims, which biases evaluation toward lexical retrieval

text: A plug for a vehicle tow-bar recess has a round end and a squared end joined by side walls, fitting tightly to seal out water, dirt, salt, and rust while staying secure during hard stops and absorbing oil to protect the bar.

One-piece cover for a vehicle’s recessed tow-bar pocket, with a round end, a straight-ended section, and two connected tubular sections sized so the first is six to twelve times longer than the second.

A vehicle tire reinforcement ply uses one flattened metal strand coated with rubber, set with its narrow axis through the ply thickness, and the coating has a dynamic stiffness of 7 to 20 MPa at 70°C under low strain.
Tire tread with a surface channel over a reinforcing cord, where the rubber depth from the channel bottom to the cord is 1.0 to 4.0 mm.

A vehicle wheel covering has a rim lip outside the bead area, made from rubber that resists ozone and wear from repeated bending, with a harder rubber layer between the lip and bead to improve stability and straight-line tracking.

Pneumatic wheel covering with a bead area and an outer flange, where the flange uses a rubber blend of polybutadiene and natural rubber, and a harder reinforcing rubber layer sits between the flange and bead area.
Wheel covering with a side panel that accepts a decorative side insert through an anchor area. The anchor uses a recessed pocket and a raised stepped feature with two widths differing by 1 to 4 mm.

A wheel covering with two lateral walls and beads has one wall shaped to hold a sidewall insert by a long groove in the outer rubber layer, with a raised ridge inside the groove, where the groove is at least 2 mm deep and narrow relative to section height.

Heavy-duty vehicle wheel covering with a carcass and at least five reinforcing plies in the tread region, including one ply with low-stiffness textile cords, edge rubber that stretches a lot and loses little energy, and optionally a very flexible filler rubber with low heat buildup.

A vehicle wheel has a multilayer belt between the tread and carcass, with at least five metal-cord plies, an outer elastic cord ply, angled working plies, side filler rubber, and highly stretchable low-loss cushioning rubber near the belt edges.

A pressurized vehicle wheel covering with layered crossing cord plies has one ply made of very high-strength steel wires embedded in rubber, spaced roughly parallel, with wire thickness and near-zero twist over a set length to cut cost and rolling drag.

Search for a vehicle wheel covering with all cord layers using steel single wires 0.33–0.37 mm thick, each with about 3080 N/mm tensile strength and no twist over a length 200 times the wire diameter.

Waterproof flying-and-submersible drone with propellers that change speed, direction, and reverse spin for control in air and water, plus buoyant housing and onboard video recording. Uses machine learning to detect people and objects underwater.
Unmanned vehicle that travels in air, then changes to a second operating state and moves underwater.

Motorcycle wheel covering with a removable side patch that can be attached or taken off while the wheel remains on the vehicle. The patch has two open ends so it fits onto the side area without removing the wheel assembly.

Wheel side protection pieces are wrapped around a fork arm and can be taken off again. Each piece has free end edges and alternating covered and exposed sections, with fastening that lets the piece pass around the arm.

Airplane wheel covering with a radial fabric carcass using composite cords containing at least one aramid filament yarn, placed nearly radial and chosen for high strength, at least 4.6% to 6.5% stretch at one-quarter breaking load, and yarn fineness above 210 tex.

A pneumatic wheel structure has several textile plies running nearly radially and fixed to bead-region hoops, using composite cords with aromatic polyamide filaments that have high strength, high tenacity, and 4.6% to 6.5% stretch at one-quarter breaking load.

A wheeled support for a mobile robot uses a spring-loaded skid that drops to the floor under downward load to help prevent tipping. Hazard zones near edges can be mapped so the robot slows down there to reduce shaking or spills.
A movable platform with several wheel units, each wheel unit built like the described caster design.

Wheel assembly with a wheel part and optionally a hub part that passes drive force from a shaft, where the wheel-side flange has an inner wall shaped with two differently directed recessed surfaces to help expel debris.
A wheel part has one drain path along the inside face of the rim flange and another drain path along the inside face of the cover attachment section.

A vehicle air-filled wheel covering can be made with non-contacting parts formed from rubber blends that are over 89% from renewable sources. The renewable content is verified by carbon-14 testing, and an RFID label on the inner lining indicates the level of bio-based material.

A wheel covering made mainly from diene rubber with more than 35% by weight synthetic polymer, and over 85% of the total made from low-emission, resource-saving, recycled, renewable, bio-based, or mass-balance materials with verifiable bio content and radiocarbon checking.

Wheel tread with one or more pattern segments containing a lengthwise stiffening strip made from a rubber blend whose dynamic shear stiffness is at least double that of the surrounding segments, using a diene rubber, high-surface carbon black, epoxy resin, amine curing agent, and crosslinking package.
rubber wheel covering with a surrounding strengthening band made of a specially formulated material.

A pneumatic wheel covering with textile body cords, an outer reinforcing layer, and an outer wrap made of rubber containing parallel textile cords. Each cord has exactly two equally sized polyamide 6.6 yarns twisted together.

A rubber wheel assembly has a body layer, an outer reinforcement layer, and a separate outer fabric ply made of parallel two-ply polyamide cords embedded in rubber, with the cords showing a specified stiffness at 4% stretch.

Wheel-covering air mover with a hollow, squeezable duct running along part of the rim circumference and an inner ring positioned so its outer edge sits at about the same radial distance from the rotation axis as the duct’s lower side.
Wheel covering with a flexible chamber that uses rotating motion to squeeze fluid toward an opening, driving a generator that turns the moving fluid’s energy into electricity.
Robotic vehicle with a low-mounted chassis, two powered wheels, and multiple ball supports arranged to lower the center of gravity and steady movement.
Mobile robot base with two or more powered wheels and several ball-type supports mounted in internal frames to lower the center of gravity and stabilize motion.

Rear bicycle hub with an internal coupling that uses a ring-shaped insert on an inner collar and a springy ring in a side groove to lock the collar inside the hub shell and engage the one-way drive mechanism.
A hub link uses a ring seated in a side groove of a coupling part so the ring can spring outward against the inside of the housing and lock the coupling part in place.
Vehicle wheel support assembly with a bearing unit, a carrier, and a rotation sensor, plus a cover that keeps dirt out of the bearing and has an integral shield protecting the sensor.
A cover made of two separately molded plastic parts, one being a flow-directing piece made by injecting resin into a mold, then joined to a molded main cover body.

Heavy-duty truck wheel covering tread made from a sulfur-curable rubber blend of natural rubber and polydiene rubber, with high carbon black loading and a cure package using zinc activator, organic activator, and sulfenamide, dithiocarbamate, plus thiazole or thiuram polysulfide accelerators.

Making a tire part from a rubber blend of natural and synthetic diene rubber, lots of carbon black, optional liquid softener or wax, and a sulfur cure package with zinc activator plus sulfenamide, dithiocarbamate, and thiazole or thiuram accelerators.
Ground wheel assembly with a sliding support and a spring element that compresses under a set load, lowering the frame so its lower edge touches the floor and increases drag to resist movement.

A support base with a downward-open housing and top cover, a vertically sliding internal bracket, a floor wheel on one side and a spring element on the other, where added load compresses the spring so the base edge touches the floor and resists rolling.

A pneumatic wheel covering has a reinforcement ply wrapped around a rim bead, with inner-liner spacing at the widest point, at 30% height, and at the ply turnback start kept within specified ratios to control sidewall shape and self-contact.
Wheel covering geometry with the widest point located at 50–60% of section height from the base, and section height and ground-contact width set to 55–65% and 60–90% of section width, respectively.

Non-inflatable wheel covering with a surrounding tread and multiple downward supports from the ring, each support having a lengthwise reinforcement layer that wraps around an axially oriented end piece.

A wheel cover with a ring-shaped body and an outer running surface, supported by multiple downward struts. Each strut has an axial extension at its end and a reinforcing sheet running along the strut and around that extension.

Electric bicycle wheel assembly with a brake rotor and rotating sensor ring secured to the hub by a threaded clamp, where a mounting part locks the rotor against twist and the ring is held by the same nut.
A sensing ring is press-fit directly onto a fastening nut, using a matching notch and bump between them to lock the connection.
Single-track vehicle wheel with two spaced plate-like supports on the rim, tapering toward the hub and joined to form an internal void, plus an opening in the rim channel leading into that void.

A wheel for a single-track vehicle has a central hub, an outer rim, and two spaced side plates that taper toward the hub and join to form an internal hollow space, with an opening in the rim channel leading into that space.

Two-wheel vehicle wheel covering with a tread, sidewalls, and bead areas, using two carcass layers: an outer layer wraps over the sidewall under the tread and ends there, while an inner layer starts near the crown and ends under a bead guard strip for better puncture protection and low rolling resistance.
bicycle wheel covering designed to be used with an inner tube.
Caster wheel with a wheel cover wrapped around a rim, using multiple joined radial supports that touch a central bearing to improve heat flow and allow fast, simple manufacture.
A wheel assembly with a central axle support inside a rim, where the outer tread wraps around the rim and multiple attached radial supports in the tread touch or are joined to the central support.
One-piece wheel axle unit with a tube, a forward frame mounting arm, a rear arm for a springy support, and a brake backing plate all formed together to simplify assembly.

A vehicle axle bracket has a cast-in front arm and a pinned, bolted rear arm with top and bottom plates, fixed seats, and a spring mount tab. The plates taper toward the front and are stiffened by several ribs with chamfered joints.

A wheel drive has a support frame with a rotatable outer body and an inner cylindrical body, two separate motor inputs, geared linkages to drive either part, and a controller that switches them independently so the vehicle can move in any direction.
Gear train with multiple supported intermediate gears, bevel gears that redirect drive toward a drum, and belts linking pulleys on the bevel gears to pulleys on the drum unit.

Low-profile rolling wheel assembly with a plate-like carrier having an opening for the wheel and a turning joint that supports the opening’s outer edge so the whole unit can be made shorter in height.

Swivel wheel assembly with a plate having a circular groove on its underside, several rollers in the groove, and a support attached to the plate so it can turn sideways with the wheel mount, with the outer edge held by the support and pressing up against the rollers.

Fabric with parallel metal-strengthening strands running lengthwise across a rubber blend containing filler and curing agents, each strand having a cross-section that fits within a rectangle of width W and height T.

Rubber blend with filler and cure package containing embedded metal reinforcements sized to fit a rectangle, where the fabric strength per width equals the metal element breaking strength and spacing is at least 0.8 times that strength.

Air-filled wheel covering with a built-in radio tag uses a protective jacket whose stiffness at freezing temperatures is limited and whose 0°C stiffness stays within a set mid-range, helping the tag remain protected without becoming too rigid.
A radio tag with a chip substrate storing information and a coiled antenna for sending and receiving data.

Rubber blends for wheel-covering parts use a diene base with two mineral fillers: one chemically treated high-area silica and one untreated lower-area silica, selected by specific surface-area ranges.
Rubber mix containing 100 to 115 parts of reinforcing material per 100 parts of rubber.
Molded support parts for airless wheel coverings used on vehicle wheels and similar rolling equipment. Also a method for making the molded part for those airless wheel coverings.
A molded body with a hollow tube core and one or more outer foam layers, where the core and foam are formed together and the tube cavity contains reinforcing rods to keep it rigid.

Vehicle wheel tread with a slit between two raised sections, where each section has angled flat faces meeting at a rounded end, and the slit has an outer zigzag, a middle 3D section, and an inner zigzag.

A tire tread block split by a slit has opposing side parts with raised and recessed features made of three right-angled flat faces meeting at a rounded end. The slit has an outer zigzag section, a middle 3D section, and an inner zigzag section.

A rotating fixture system prewinds seat-belt reel assemblies, locates a notch by sensing, and installs a cover plate with a multi-axis robot, while vision and motor feedback control winding count and torque for different product sizes.
search query text: multi-axis robot at a setup station places or adjusts a barrier element using a winding device.
Wheel covering with a tread channel that can be cut deeper at least once, where after recutting the channel depth is at least 70% of its original depth when new.
search for a wheel covering with grooves that, after recutting, leaves a remaining tread height measured from the outer surface to the groove base
Wheel assembly with one rotating member on a fixed axis and another rotating member whose axis position can shift, while that second member also moves sideways relative to the first.

A rotatable adjustable wheel part has a radial support linked to it, and a guide tube with a through-hole receives the support; the support shifts in the hole as the adjustable part moves relative to the drive part.

A detachable wheel cap uses a central shaft unit with an outer tube, a spring-loaded button, and a ring contact. The outer tube partly surrounds the button body, and the spring pushes the button and ring in opposite directions to release the cap from the wheel.

A detachable wheel cap has a disc with a shaft unit that fits into a hub opening and locks there. The shaft unit includes a hollow outer sleeve surrounding a spring-loaded push button and ring contact, with the spring urging the ring and button in opposite directions.

A swivel wheel unit has a moving holder, an axle, a wheel mounted on the axle, and a spring that lets the holder shift up and down. A brake uses a hard toothed ring on the wheel and a softer curved pad on the holder to slow wheel rotation.

A rolling wheel mount has a spring-loaded housing that moves up and down on a shaft, plus a brake with a toothed ring on the wheel and a smooth curved pad on the housing that presses against it to slow turning. The ring is harder than the pad, and the pad engages only when the housing drops.

A pneumatic wheel covering has a body ply, a breaker stack, and reinforcement rubber strips. The folded ply end includes three sections, with the middle section length set to 0.8 to 1.4 times the combined lengths of the inner and outer sections.
A wheel covering has a rubber layer next to the outer lateral side of the third section, with that layer being 2.0 to 6.0 mm thick.
